delivery_checks: Receive the production-approved long-form video and its signed title and category from content-engine's piece manifest; do not cut or derive video in Growth.
Before Krish sees it: the draft's words, title, alt text and asset hash match the piece manifest exactly (engine/run/piece_manifest.py), or it is held as manifest_differs.
Its first real post is the route's one capability check, approved by Krish on its Monday through growth.py run release; until it passes, the route holds.
Bind publication approval to the exact account, title, description, asset hash, category and proposed time.
After a save, wait and independently reopen; reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying.
measurements: Dated exposed reach and meaningful engagement, preserving missing values.
Relevant follower/profile movement and source-attributed publication subscriptions where exposed.
24-hour, 72-hour and seven-day readback after actual publication; no financial ROI inference from draft counts.
